notes.title: Mixed Reality Support with Liv
notes.content:
Attention Streamers!

Cactus Cowboy now supports Mixed Reality Streaming via Liv as well as the Quest version supports MRC via Liv Mobile.



This update fixes a bug in Level 9 that can cause the game to crash.

notes.title: Quality Improvement Patch
notes.content:
After userfeedback about my speedrun mode, listened and added some more speedrunner features.

Added live time stats. To be enabled in main menu > options for proper speedruns 
(current known best is 4h btw)

You can see your current time, current run and level best in-game now.
	
[list]
[*] Reworked ammo box 3d model
[*] Fixed Snap Turn option in main menu
[*] Realigned main menu > options
[*] Fixed floating tree in Level 3
[*] Fixed enemy disappearing in Level 3
[*] Fixed gitch in ammo pickup
[*] Fixed mesh in Level 14 where you could glitch though the level
[/list]


Free updates for a free game. I hope you'll like the new ammo box and features.

notes.title: Snapturn Patch
notes.content:
A nice person asked for snap turn and here it is.

[list]
[*] Snap turn added
[*] Turn speed adjustable in hand menu
[/list]

I didn't think it was important when developing for Quest since you can turn without wires. Well, you never stop learning.

notes.title: Anti Frustration and Speed Runner Update
notes.content:
After some community feedback, I started working hard to make the game less frustrating without sacrificing the general difficulty. I want the game hard, if you still can't make it, find the Cheater mode.

Here are the Update News:

[list]
[*] [b]Extra Menu added (needs to be unlocked)[/b]
[*] [b]Speedrunner Stats! Unlock them after finish the game once[/b]
[*] [b]Frustration Fix! Pits, Lava, Acid, deep water is less deadly now (repawns!)[/b]
[*] Enemy Wiki (needs to be unlocked)
[*] Menu fix (Missing skyboy, back button didnt work - how could I miss that)
[*] Credit fix, Cactus Cowboy didn't shoot rockets anymore
[*] Fix return to Menu could crash the game
[*] Glitch fixes
[*] Climb Stone Material Fix
[*] Spelling Mistakes
[*] Object clipping fixes
[/list]


The Speedrun Log saves the overall best and the current run times. If you start a new game, your current run will be reset, however, you can ofc pause and continue another day.
